name: io.github.hiberus-magento/magento-rest
title: Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce (REST)
description: Read and act on a Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce store through its REST API.

environmentVariables.name: MAGENTO_REST_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The store's REST root, ending in /rest/V1 (or /rest/<store_code>/V1 for one store view). Must be https.

environmentVariables.name: MAGENTO_REST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The Access Token of a Magento integration (System > Extensions > Integrations), sent as a Bearer. Magento 2.4.4+ also needs Stores > Configuration > Services > OAuth > Consumer Settings > Allow OAuth Access Tokens to be used as standalone Bearer tokens = Yes.

environmentVariables.name: MAGENTO_REST_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to load, e.g. products,orders. Empty loads every REST group. Groups: products, store, categories, customers, orders, sales-documents, stock, carts, cms, attributes, media, promotions, tax, analytics.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_WRITES_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: When true, write tools are listed and callable; otherwise only read tools exist.
